Frontiers in Neuroscience, 2024. doi: 10.3389/fnins.2024.1373515'. `uvx opencite lookup` on that DOI confirms it (PMID 38765672, PMCID PMC11099244, 69 citations). LICENCE -- read from the PDF's own front-matter block, verbatim: 'COPYRIGHT (c) 2024 Brookshire, Kasper, Blauch, Wu, Glatt, Merrill, Gerrol, Yoder, Quirk and Lucero. This is an open-access article distributed under the terms of the Creative Commons Attribution License (CC BY).' OpenAlex independently reports license 'cc-by', oa_status 'gold'. PDF archived. AUTHOR NAME -- OpenAlex renders the fourth author as 'Yunan "Charles" Wu' with typographic quotes; the PDF title block prints 'Yunan Charles Wu' without them, and that form is used in the card and bib. EXTRACTION -- markitdown. Frontiers two-column layout, and the conversion interleaves the two columns line by line: a sentence from the left column is followed by an unrelated fragment from the right, with much of the text additionally wrapped in malformed markdown tables. This is the most disruptive conversion in the batch and md_quality is rough for that reason. Usable: all six reported accuracy figures with their confidence intervals (99.8 / 99.1-100.0, 53.0 / 43.1-64.8, 79.1 / 78.8-79.4, 65.1 / 61.3-69.1), both Wilcoxon statistics, the survey counts (63 papers, 17 at 27.0 percent), and the full apparatus descriptions all survive as continuous phrases and were read directly. Table 1, the per-study survey listing, survives as legible two-column rows and confirms the counts. Unusable: Figures 1-4 yield captions only, which matters for the training-curve claims (Figure 3) -- those are carded from the body prose that describes the figure, not from the figure. Numbers quoted on the card were cross-checked against the archived PDF, which is committed alongside.
